detail: Only 95 patients have positive/non-error age, height, weight, and BMI values simultaneously; BMI is available for 130.
Source header is height_cm, but observed values are 1.6 to 1.8 and were interpreted as metres without modifying the source file.
Among complete cases, median absolute recorded-versus-calculated BMI difference is 3.39; only 34.7% are within 2 BMI units. Recorded BMI was retained rather than recomputed.
The 312-patient native-missing analysis can exploit missingness patterns; interpret it as secondary and audit data-source patterns before clinical claims.
The exact seven v7 variables were selected with the same 219 labels. v8 reuse is not an independent validation even though the panel is fixed during its CV.
Clinical complete-case models contain no missing values; the full-cohort XGBoost receives NaN values and missingness indicators, with no mean or median substitution.
The all-312 analysis uses global MRI features and omits slip-segment localization entirely.
